# Military.com

> Military.com is the leading online resource for U.S. military news, veteran benefits, career guidance, and military service information across all branches.

Military.com provides comprehensive coverage of all five military branches (Army, Navy, Air Force, Marine Corps, Coast Guard, and Space Force) along with extensive resources for military benefits including pay, education, health care, and veteran employment. The site serves active-duty service members, veterans, and military families with daily news, career resources, and benefit guidance.

## Key Topics

- Military News
- Veteran Benefits
- GI Bill
- Military Pay
- VA Health Care
- TRICARE
- Military Careers
- Service Members
- Military Fitness
- Veteran Jobs
- Military Education
- Pentagon
- Defense Policy
- National Guard
- Military Headlines

## Military Service Branches

- [US Army News, Army Pay & Fitness Resources](https://www.military.com/army): U.S. Army news, pay, fitness resources, uniforms, and training information.
- [US Navy News, Navy Pay, Fitness Resources](https://www.military.com/navy): U.S. Navy news, pay, fitness resources, and operational updates.
- [US Air Force News, Pay, Fitness Resources](https://www.military.com/air-force): U.S. Air Force news, pay, promotions, fitness, and career resources.
- [US Marine Corps News, Marine Pay & Fitness Resources](https://www.military.com/marine-corps): U.S. Marine Corps news, pay, promotions, fitness, and training resources.
- [US Coast Guard News, Coast Guard Pay & Fitness Resources](https://www.military.com/coast-guard): U.S. Coast Guard news, pay, fitness, equipment, and career information.
- [United States Space Force](https://www.military.com/space-force): Overview of the U.S. Space Force, newest military service branch.

## Military Benefits & Compensation

- [Military Benefits News and Resources](https://www.military.com/benefits): Comprehensive military benefits information: health, education, discounts, jobs.
- [Military Pay, Resources, Articles, Military Pay Charts](https://www.military.com/benefits/military-pay): Military pay charts, calculators, BAH, BAS, and compensation information.
- [GI Bill, Montgomery and Post 9/11 GI Bills](https://www.military.com/education/gi-bill): GI Bill programs including Post-9/11, Montgomery, and vocational benefits.
- [Veterans Health Care, Guides to the VA](https://www.military.com/benefits/veterans-health-care): VA health care guidance, CHAMPVA, disability care, and veteran resources.
- [Tricare, Tricare Programs](https://www.military.com/benefits/tricare): Tricare military health insurance overview, plans, and coverage information.

## Military News & Content

- [Military Daily News, Military Headlines](https://www.military.com/daily-news): Daily U.S. military news updates including gear, breaking news, and international coverage.
- [Military News and Opinion Articles](https://www.military.com/daily-news/opinion): Military opinion and editorial articles on policy and veteran issues.
- [Military Videos](https://www.military.com/video): Military videos featuring Army, Navy, Air Force, Marines, Coast Guard, Space Force.
- [Military Podcasts](https://www.military.com/podcasts): Military.com podcast directory covering news, benefits, and military issues.

## Home & Overview

- [Military and Veteran Benefits, News, Veteran Jobs](https://www.military.com): Military.com homepage offering military benefits, news, jobs, and discounts.
